import asyncio
import os
import pathlib
import sys
from typing import Optional

import modal
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download

APP_NAME = "glm47-b200-server"
REPO_ID_DEFAULT = "zai-org/GLM-4.7"
MODAL_TOKEN_ID_SECRET = "MODAL_TOKEN_ID"
MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET_SECRET = "MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET"

hf_cache_vol = modal.Volume.from_name("hf-hub-cache", create_if_missing=True)
modal_token_id_secret = modal.Secret.from_name(MODAL_TOKEN_ID_SECRET)
modal_token_secret_secret = modal.Secret.from_name(MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET_SECRET)

base_image = (
    modal.Image.debian_slim(python_version="3.11")
    .apt_install("git", "curl")
    .pip_install(
        "huggingface_hub[hf_transfer]==0.25.2",
        "hf_transfer==0.1.16",
        "vllm==0.8.5.post1",
        "fastapi==0.115.0",
        "uvicorn[standard]==0.32.0",
        "pydantic==2.9.2",
        "torch==2.6.0",
        "transformers==4.49.2",
        "tokenizers==0.20.9",
        "--index-url ",
    )
    .env(
        {
            "HF_HOME": "/root/.cache/huggingface",
            "HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER": "1",
            "VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE": "false",
            "VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND": "FLASHINFER",
            "VLLM_DISABLE_LOG_STATS": "true",
            "VLLM_ENGINE": "vllm.engine.v1.v1_async_llm_engine.AsyncLLMEngine",
        }
    )
)

image = base_image

secrets = [
    modal_token_id_secret,
    modal_token_secret_secret
]

@modal.app(app_name=APP_NAME, image=image, secrets=secrets)
class GLM47Server:
    @modal.enter()
    def setup(self):
        os.environ["MODAL_TOKEN_ID"] = self.modal_token_id_secret.get()
        os.environ["MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET"] = self.modal_token_secret_secret.get()
        print("Environment variables set")

    @modal.method(
        gpu="B200",
        timeout=7200,
        volumes={"/root/.cache/huggingface": hf_cache_vol},
        memory=32768
    )
    def download_model(self, repo_id: str = REPO_ID_DEFAULT, revision: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
        print(f"Downloading {repo_id} revision {revision or 'default'}")
        local_path = snapshot_download(
            repo_id=repo_id,
            revision=revision,
            cache_dir="/root/.cache/huggingface",
            local_dir_use_symlinks=False,
            resume_download=True,
            max_workers=8
        )
        model_path = pathlib.Path(local_path)
        total_bytes = sum(f.stat().st_size for f in model_path.rglob("*") if f.is_file())
        print(f"Downloaded model path: {local_path}")
        print(f"Total size: {total_bytes / 1024**3:.2f} GiB")
        hf_cache_vol.commit()
        return str(model_path)

    @modal.method(
        gpu="B200",
        timeout=86400,
        ports=[8000],
        volumes={"/root/.cache/huggingface": hf_cache_vol},
        memory=65536,
        container_idle_timeout=3600.0
    )
    async def serve(self, repo_id: str = REPO_ID_DEFAULT, revision: Optional[str] = None, port: int = 8000):
        from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
        from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
        from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, StreamingResponse
        import uvicorn
        import json

        print("Loading model with vLLM...")
        model_path = self.download_model.remote(repo_id=repo_id, revision=revision)
        
        llm = LLM(
            model=model_path,
            tensor_parallel_size=1,
            gpu_memory_utilization=0.95,
            max_model_len=131072,
            trust_remote_code=True,
            disable_log_stats=True,
            enforce_eager=True,
            max_num_seqs=256,
            worker_use_ray=False,
            enable_prefix_caching=False,
            enable_chunked_prefill=False,
            dtype="float16",
        )

        app = FastAPI(title="GLM-4.7 B200 OpenAI Server")

        @app.get("/health")
        async def health():
            return {"status": "healthy", "model": repo_id, "gpu": "B200"}

        @app.get("/v1/models")
        async def list_models():
            return {
                "object": "list",
                "data": [{
                    "id": repo_id,
                    "object": "model",
                    "created": 1735440000,
                    "owned_by": "glm47-b200"
                }]
            }

        @app.post("/v1/chat/completions")
        async def chat_completions(request: Request):
            body = await request.json()
            messages = body.get("messages", [])
            prompt = messages[-1]["content"] if messages else ""
            
            sampling_params = SamplingParams(
                temperature=body.get("temperature", 0.7),
                top_p=body.get("top_p", 0.9),
                max_tokens=body.get("max_tokens", 2048),
                stop=body.get("stop", None),
            )
            
            results_generator = llm.generate(prompt, sampling_params)
            
            async def generate():
                async for request_output in results_generator:
                    prompt = request_output.prompt
                    output = request_output.outputs[0]
                    text = output.text
                    yield f" {json.dumps({'choices': [{'delta': {'content': text}}]})}\n\n"
                    yield " [DONE]\n\n"
            
            return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")

        config = uvicorn.Config(
            app=app,
            host="0.0.0.0",
            port=port,
            log_level="info",
            access_log=True,
            timeout_keep_alive=30,
        )
        server = uvicorn.Server(config)
        print(f"Server starting on port {port}")
        print(f"OpenAI-compatible endpoint: ")
        await server.serve()

glm47_app = GLM47Server()

@modal.app()
class LocalClient:
    @glm47_app.local_entrypoint()
    def download(self, repo_id: str = REPO_ID_DEFAULT, revision: Optional[str] = None):
        print("Downloading GLM-4.7 model...")
        path = glm47_app.download_model.remote(repo_id=repo_id, revision=revision)
        print(f"Model cached successfully: {path}")

    @glm47_app.local_entrypoint()
    def serve(self, repo_id: str = REPO_ID_DEFAULT, revision: Optional[str] = None, detach: bool = False):
        print("Starting GLM-4.7 B200 OpenAI server...")
        if detach:
            glm47_app.serve.remote(repo_id=repo_id, revision=revision, detach=True)
            print("Server started in detached mode. Check Modal dashboard for URL.")
        else:
            glm47_app.serve.remote(repo_id=repo_id, revision=revision)

    @glm47_app.local_entrypoint()
    def cli(self):
        import argparse
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="GLM-4.7 B200 Server Control")
        parser.add_argument("--repo-id", default=REPO_ID_DEFAULT, help="HuggingFace repo ID")
        parser.add_argument("--revision", default=None, help="Model revision/branch")
        parser.add_argument("--download", action="store_true", help="Download model only")
        parser.add_argument("--serve", action="store_true", help="Start server")
        parser.add_argument("--detach", action="store_true", help="Run server detached")
        args = parser.parse_args()
        
        if args.download:
            self.download(args.repo_id, args.revision)
        elif args.serve:
            self.serve(args.repo_id, args.revision, args.detach)
        else:
            parser.print_help()
